controls: fresh copied-baseline pre-fusion reforward after video derangement for P_pooled
raw-sequence video replacement followed by fresh adapter forward for R_raw_sequence
Seen localization reuses frozen spans/class logits
counterfactual_pairs: not available in these two folds under current verified annotations; do not infer absences from missing windows
fold_majority_screen: 3/4 folds applies only to expanded four-fold stage; initial pilot is not a confirmation
loss: natural-sample BCE only, same rows and number of epochs in both arms
optimizer: AdamW lr=1e-3 weight_decay=1e-4; grad norm clip 1.0
phase: two-fold, one-seed strict-inner development pilot; exploratory Novel-dev
pooled_representation: strict-inner V5 Moment pooled 256-d decoder features; same query cross-attention and scorer family
raw_representation: fold-declared CLIP 512 + SlowFast 2304 per temporal bin; min modality length used after verifying absolute difference <=1; separate LayerNorm and 16-d projections per modality
selection: inner Seen-val pooled AUROC, earliest tie
shuffled_labels: retained original labels only for input-dependence diagnosis; not relabeled benchmark and no 0.5 expectation
smoke_note: Raw one-epoch smoke was completed and its Novel-dev metric was viewed before this freeze; it is a process smoke only, not evidence or a model-selection input. The pooled one-epoch smoke is currently being debugged. Formal U untouched.
